'''''Koh-Lanta: Palawan''''' is the seventh season of ''[[Koh-Lanta]]''. It was broadcast on TF1 from June 29 to September 11, 2007, airing at 8:55&nbsp;p.m.

[[Jade Handi]] and [[Kevin Cuoco Giudicelli]] tied in a 3-3 [[jury]] vote at the [[Final Tribal Council]]. As a result, both were declared [[Sole Survivor|Dual Survivors]].

== Production ==
This season was filmed on the island of Palawan in the Philippines.

==Twists==
*'''[[Schoolyard Pick]]:''' Unlike previous seasons of [[Koh-Lanta]], on Day 1, a challenge occurred, where the two winners would determine the two [[tribe]]s for the season. [[Érick Africaa]] and [[Jade Handi]] won this challenge.
* '''Replacements:''' Due to two [[Quit|voluntary exits]], two castaways ([[Pascale Bodin]] and [[Grégoire Delachaux]]) returned to the game after being voted out.
* '''[[Tribe Switch]]:''' After winning the Reward Challenge on Day 11, [[Batang]] could permanently take one of [[Guntao]]'s members. They chose [[Érick Africaa]].

==Trivia==

* This is the second season in any [[Survivor (franchise)|''Survivor'' franchise]] to feature a tie at the [[Final Tribal Council]], following ''[[Koh-Lanta: Bocas del Toro]]''. It would later be followed by ''[[Survivor Philippines: Celebrity Showdown]]'', {{S|36}} and ''[[Koh-Lanta: Le Totem Maudit]]''.
* ''Palawan'' is the second consecutive season of ''Koh-Lanta'' to feature a [[Pagonging]], following ''[[Koh-Lanta: Vanuatu|Vanuatu]]''.
